title: Privacy-Safe Claims Run Recovery
scenario: At 7:20 a.m. the overnight Zenith claims load is failed. A partial transfer, a redelivery, ambiguous dates, sensitive member fields, and a failed downstream dbt test are present. The dashboard refresh is due at 9 a.m.
objectives: Distinguish business, arrival, and processing dates and choose a bounded recovery scope
Map supported fields, reject malformed rows, and leave unsupported fields unresolved
Remove or transform member data according to the supplied privacy policy
Use reconciliation, uniqueness, dependencies, and dbt results to decide refresh readiness

environment.access: No external network or cloud credentials
environment.resource_bounds: One local repository process, one in-memory SQL database, and supplied synthetic fixtures only
environment.cleanup: Delete generated decision records; the sandbox auto-expires after the assessment.
environment.production_approximation: SFTP, Airflow, BigQuery, dbt, and Microsoft 365 Copilot interactions are represented by deterministic evidence and local validation rather than live services.

initial_state: The initial SFTP transfer is incomplete and lacks its trailer
A complete redelivery has a different checksum
One source record is duplicated and one has an invalid date
The latest required dbt uniqueness test is failing
task: Produce one evidence-linked recovery and refresh-readiness decision record. Do not authorize a broad rerun or dashboard release while a required test is failing.
